items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: I had him and him, Hall, Jack. You remember when they? They all brought me back there.

ctx.x: Where did you know Danny from?

Well, I just knew them. She was my girl, daughter Mary. Her sister, his wife's sister is my girl daughter, father-in-law. See, you know Augie, you never met little Augie, Miss Louise Boyd. I had Johnny all of them back there one day. You know when I used to come by Johnny, I used to drink. I had him and him, Hall, Jack. You remember when they? They all brought me back there. Come sit on the garage and everything. But they didn't know I was like you. I brought them back there. They tried to bring my little girl's…
Did you ever hear Danny play music?
